summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting to signed-in account  ### What I found from a read-only audit first Before proposing changes, I traced the full path (backend `modules/watchlist/schema.ts` + `handlers.ts`, `db/auth.ts`, `server.ts` route mounting, and frontend `WatchlistPage.tsx`, `useAuth.tsx`, `lib/api.ts`, `LoginPage.tsx`, `App.tsx`). On current `master`, the chain looks correctly wired end-to-end: - Watchlists/items are owned by `user_id` in the schema, every handler filters by `eq(watchlists.user_id, userId)`, and there's no hardcoded/guest/default watchlist. - All
